changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 5 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/4730-retire-dead-locale-key-batch.md`

- names `ObjectGrid.tsx` → `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - **Superseded twin vocabularies.** `cellRender.*` and `rowAction.*` duplicated a `grid.*` vocabulary that won. `RowActionMenu.tsx` is fully i18n-wired and reads `grid.openMenu` / `grid.edit` / `grid.delete`; `ObjectGrid.tsx` reads `grid.empty` / `grid.yes` / `grid.no` / `grid.systemFields`. The twins had no reader on either side. - **Labels that outlived their control.** `calendar.agenda` labelled a view mode `b55a34647` retired from `CalendarViewMode` (now `'month' | 'week' | 'day'`). `home.quickActions.createApp*`, `layout.systemNav.createApp`, `actionDialog.defaultActionTitle` / `.ok` and `grid.bulk.selectPlaceholder` sit in namespaces whose consumers are live and wired but demonstrably read other siblings. - **Surfaces that left the product.** `map.*` is the strongest form: `@object-ui/plugin-map` declares no `@object-ui/i18n` dependency and contains no `t()` call at all, so it cannot consume a locale string. `home.stats.*` and `recordDetail.viewersTooltip` name surfaces nothing renders.

### `.changeset/6597-retire-fieldmeta-referenceto.md`

- names `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` → `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **No authoring story survived the search either.** `ObjectGrid`'s own relational-meta pass-through (`applyRelationalMeta`, `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`) copies `reference_to` / `reference` / `display_field` / etc. from the SCHEMA field def only, at all three of its call sites — never from an authored column override. No doc, example, or fixture in this repo shows a table column pinning a lookup's target away from what its schema field already says. Under the maintainer's standing startup-stage rule (2026-08-27: deprecated/alias spellings retire immediately, no transition windows), no measured demand selects withdraw.

### `.changeset/7762-object-grid-export-options-bare-array-refusal.md`

- names `ObjectGrid.tsx` → `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **What was measured, on this branch's base.** The mirror declared NO `exportOptions` member at all, and `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()`, so `ObjectGridSchema.safeParse({ type: 'object-grid', objectName: 'accounts', exportOptions: ['csv', 'xlsx'] })` returned `success: true` with the array back VERBATIM — as did `{ formats: ['csv', 'pdf'], compression: 'gzip' }`. Nothing on the render path parses, and `ObjectGrid.tsx` reads `schema.exportOptions?.formats` and only that, so the authored array then lost SILENTLY to the `['csv', 'json']` default: the `useEffect` that warns about dropped formats reads `.formats` too and returns early when it is absent, while `!!schema.exportOptions` kept the export button on screen. An author declared `['csv', 'xlsx']` and got csv/json with no error, no warning and no console line. The two authoring faces disagreed in the direction opposite to objectui#6956's: the TypeScript interface already declared the object form only, so TS refused what zod admitted.

### `.changeset/9722-bulk-executor-datasource-face.md`

- names `ObjectGrid.tsx` → `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `ObjectGrid.tsx` → `RecordDetailPanel`: removing it type-checks GREEN. It was paying for nothing — both sides already declare the same `DataSource | undefined` from `@object-ui/types`. Removed outright. - `ObjectGrid.tsx` → `BulkActionDialog`: removing it reddens, and it was paying for TWO things at once — the optional-vs-required arm (the grid declares `dataSource?: DataSource`, the dialog demands one) AND the bulk-door contravariance. Only the first still needs erasing, so it is now a non-null assertion: today's runtime behaviour is preserved exactly, and any future drift of the face reddens at that site instead of passing silently.

### `.changeset/9853-grid-non-positive-page-size.md`

- names `ObjectGrid.tsx` → `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Refuse a non-positive `pageSize` at all three of `ObjectGrid.tsx`'s read points, instead of giving two different answers for one authored value (objectui#9853).

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `d1e683fa1` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1755 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2361 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36590838031)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ac8ff01c00864149191f65b6ec3e9e79c18621a4`
Local-runs: none

PR objectui#11118 (`Part of #10993`, batch 3) at the head above against `main`. Inputs read at 2026-09-29T15:47Z: card #10993's body and all 14 comments (triage `5872631146`, release `5891805616`, claim `5892009055`, dev report `5893459423`), the PR body, its 5-file list, the net diff and the head's check-runs (`filter=latest`); head blobs read for context only: `ObjectGrid.tsx`, plugin-grid `index.tsx`, `columnSpellingDiagnostics.ts`, core `utils/export-filename.ts`, plugin-dashboard `DrillDownDrawer.tsx` / `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx` / `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, the amended pin, and `packages/types` `objectql.ts` / `zod/objectql.zod.ts`. Scope judged: release `5891805616` "Batch 3" as narrowed by claim `5892009055`, plus the seat's mid-run amendment (the plugin-dashboard pin; named in the PR body, not yet on the card).

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The two `title` reads — right.** At the base both sites read `resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.label, displayLocale) || schema.title` (`:3931` export `viewLabel`, `:5122` caption; the diff hunks at 3928 and 5119 show them). At the head both read `resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.label, displayLocale) || resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.title, displayLocale)`: `resolveInlineI18nLabel` is the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` imported from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (`ObjectGrid.tsx:50`) and `displayLocale` is `useDisplayLocale()` (`:1459`), the same resolver and locale `label` takes, with `label` first. Both sinks are string sinks: `buildExportFileName`'s `viewLabel?: string` passes through `sanitizeFileNameBase`, which is `String(raw)` (core `export-filename.ts:27`, `:50`), the `[object Object]` the changeset names; `caption` on the data-table schema reaches the caption as a React child. The fall-through order is preserved: a plain-string `title` renders as authored, and a `label` that resolves to nothing (`''`, an entry-less map) falls to `title` exactly as the overlay comment at `:5436` documents the resolver's falsy answers.
2. **No other raw `title` read reaching a string sink — right.** A sweep of every `title` token in the head `ObjectGrid.tsx`: `:3034` `columnDiagnosticLabel = schema.label ?? (schema as { title?: unknown }).title` feeds `describeUnresolvedColumns` whose `describeAddress` pushes the hint only when the value is a non-empty string (`typeof label === 'string'` and a positive length, `columnSpellingDiagnostics.ts:200`), so a map drops the hint and nothing stringifies; `:5441` the record-detail overlay heading reads `label` only; `:5885` / `:6228` / `:6288` pass that `detailTitle`; `:5941` is a literal; `:5662` / `:5777` are comments. Nothing else.
3. **Accept set and public surface — right that none moves.** `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` is untouched and `title` stays one of the ten deliberately unregistered `@deprecated` spellings (the header note in plugin-grid `index.tsx`: publishing a deprecated alias would harden a second dialect, AGENTS.md #0.1, each with a cited parity exemption). So no manifest row, no `MEMBER_PINS` row and no `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` edit, correctly; `validateTree` and `safeValidateSchema` read `title` exactly as before. What moves is render behaviour on a key the registry does not publish: a spec-valid map on `title` now renders the display-locale entry instead of `Component "data-table" failed to render`. The diff carries no export, type or registration change (5 files: one source edit, one new pin, one changeset, one comment edit, one test amendment).
4. **The new pin `ObjectGrid.titleI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` — right.** The real `SchemaRenderer` and the registered block (`import '../index'`), `en` listed first so a first-entry or `en` fallback fails the zh rows; seven rows: caption zh and en, a plain-string control, `label` wins when both are authored, an empty `label` falls through to the `title` map (pins the `||` order), the export file name under zh (`/^contacts-客户-\d{8}-\d{6}\.csv$/`, the second sink the caption rows cannot reach) and its plain-string control. The export leg spies `HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click` to read `download`; the `URL.createObjectURL` polyfill is typed (commit `ac8ff01c0` removed the two `any` casts). The red-on-base and per-site ablation counts in the PR body (4 / 3, 1 / 6, 4 / 3) are the dev's measurements; the head's test shards are the gate.
5. **The amended helper `drawerNamed(name)` — right, and deterministic whether or not the drill-down resolved.** `screen.findByRole('dialog', { name })` matches the dialog by its accessible name: `DrillDownDrawer` renders `title` inside `SheetTitle` / `DialogTitle` (the Radix title the content's `aria-labelledby` points at), so the name is the drawer title alone, and the body contributes nothing to it. The old `within(dialog).getByRole('heading')` also matched the body's `WidgetEmptyState` → `DataEmptyState` `h3` (`WidgetEmptyState.tsx:104` styles that `h3` child by selector) once the empty result rendered, which is the race merge-group run 36581157753 lost. The drawer title is `resolveDrillTitle(…, titleText || labelText || 'Details')` with `pickLocalized(title | label, language)` (`ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:548-550`), so the four rows still assert the resolved zh / en text by exact name. Same-shape search over the other batch-2 pins: the dev reports one hit, the fixed one; nothing in this diff carries an unnamed heading query (the two grid pins read a `caption` element).
6. **The header-comment edit in `ObjectGrid.labelI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx`, outside the claim — right.** Two comment lines whose base sentence ("that fallback still reads a map raw … held to a later batch") this diff makes false; they now name the new pin. No assertion or behaviour change.
7. **The changeset body — right.** It describes the two sites, the display-locale channel in the words `label`'s registration description uses, `label` still winning, a plain-string `title` unchanged, and "no registry input changes".
8. **Check-runs on the head** (`filter=latest`, read after the last run completed): 43 runs, all completed, 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure. The three skips are the standing ones (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, the coverage-shard stub). `Test (shard 1/8)` through `Test (shard 8/8)`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Build & E2E`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`, `Shell Escape Residue Scan`, the `Test` rollup and the five changeset gates (`Declaration`, `Bump Policy`, `Fixed Group Check`, `Claim Re-read`, `Overwrite Report`) are success. These conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was run locally.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/10993-batch3-grid-title.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-grid': patch` — **right**. A render repair on an unregistered deprecated key: no registry input, type, export or accepted set moves (the objectui mirror `ObjectGridSchema.title` stays `string` in TS and `z.string()` in zod at this head), so nothing a consumer wrote is newly accepted or refused at the contract; a `title` map that crashed the block now renders. Batch 2 took `minor` on plugin-grid because its registration widened; this batch widens no registration.
- `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: the amended pin is test-only, no changeset owed. `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check` and `Changeset Claim Re-read` are green on the head.
- The PR body's `Clause-②: no` line — **confirmed**, and it matches the claim `5892009055`. No `needs:contract-review` marker is owed; this record is on the head regardless.
- The five pending changesets that name `ObjectGrid.tsx` (re-read comment `5893393170`): `4730` (locale keys the grid reads), `6597` (`applyRelationalMeta`), `7762` (`exportOptions` bare-array refusal), `9722` (`dataSource` casts) and `9853` (`pageSize`). Read against the diff: none describes the caption or the export `viewLabel`, so none went false.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `5893459423`: `open_questions: []`. Its deviations and findings, each answered:

1. **Resumed run** (`e81da1781` from the killed run, two commits on top, no force-push, the claim still names the branch): the whole net diff was judged (5 files, +222 / −12) and the history is context.
